basic_details.job_title: Ajara Mahavidyalaya Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 6 Principal, Assistant Professor Posts
basic_details.department: Assistant Professor subjects: Economics, English, Marathi, Mathematics, Zoology
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the age limit, the application fee, the pay amounts or the selection process.

qualification.details: The notice does not print a degree or experience requirement for either post. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay scales as prescribed by the Apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time

how_to_apply: Candidates are to apply giving full particulars within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement to the undersigned, that is the Chairman, Janata Education Society, Ajara, Dist.- Kolhapur. The notice is dated 19/11/2026 and says it is to be published at www.unishivaji.ac.in, so the deadline works out to about 4 December 2026 (15 days from 19 November 2026). The notice does not print a postal address, submission method or application form for the application itself.
Incomplete applications will not be entertained.
Reserved category candidates are advised to send a copy of their application to the Deputy Registrar, Special Cell, Shivaji University, Kolhapur- 416004 (Room No. 138).
important_instructions: Reserve category candidates from outside the State of Maharashtra will be treated as Open Category. Reservation for VJNT categories is internally transferable. The recruitment procedure is subject to the decision of the Hon. Bombay High Court, Aurangabad Bench, on writ petition No. 12051/2015. The recruitment process will be carried out subject to the final outcome of cases currently pending in various courts regarding social and parallel reservations. The vacant posts and all terms and conditions apply as mentioned in No Objection letters No. JDHE/Kolhapur/NOC/2026/00016 and JDHE/Kolhapur/NOC/2026/00013, both dated 29.10.2026, from the Deputy Secretary (Higher Education), Mantralaya, Mumbai.

rows.details: Janata Education Society's Ajara Mahavidyalaya, Ajara (affiliated to Shivaji University, Kolhapur)
Assistant Professor subjects: Economics, English, Marathi, Mathematics, Zoology
Pay scales as prescribed by the Apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time
Principal: 5 years from the date of appointment or up to the age of superannuation, whichever is earlier

content_sections.heading: About Ajara Mahavidyalaya
content_sections.text: Ajara Mahavidyalaya is a college at Ajara, Tal. Ajara, Dist. Kolhapur, Maharashtra, run by Janata Education Society. Its letterhead describes it as affiliated to Shivaji University, Kolhapur, and marks it "Permanently Granted". The notice is signed by the Chairman of Janata Education Society, Ajara, at Ajara on 19/11/2026.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice states that the post of Principal is treated as open category as per the decision of the Hon'ble High Court, Aurangabad Bench, W/P No. 3108/2023, the special leave petition before the Hon'ble Supreme Court, W/P No. 4172/2024, and letter No. RJD/HE/KD/CIRCULAR/2024/2119 dated 09/05/2024 of the Regional Joint Director, Kolhapur Region, Kolhapur.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice does not print a degree or experience requirement for either post. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

rows.qualification: As per Government Resolution No. Misc-2018/C.R.56/18/UNI-1, dated 08th March, 2019, which the notice says remains in force for educational qualification and pay scales of the Principal post
As prescribed by the Apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Educational qualifications, pay scales and service conditions are as prescribed by the Apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time. No pay amount is printed. Principal: appointment is for a period of 5 years from the date of appointment or up to the attainment of the age of superannuation of the candidate, whichever is earlier. The Government Resolution dated 08th March, 2019 for educational qualification and pay scales remains in force for the Principal post. All terms and conditions apply as mentioned in the GR dated 12.11.2021 of the Higher and Technical Education Department of Government of Maharashtra.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Ajara Mahavidyalaya Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications will not be entertained. Reserved category candidates are advised to send a copy of their application to the Deputy Registrar, Special Cell, Shivaji University, Kolhapur- 416004 (Room No. 138).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Reserved category candidates: Caste Validity Certificate, as per the directions of the State Government in Circular No. BCC-2011/Pra. Kra 1064/2011/16-B, dated 12-12-2011. Reserved category candidates except SC/ST: Non-Creamy layer certificate, to be produced at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Reserve category candidates from outside the State of Maharashtra will be treated as Open Category. Reservation for VJNT categories is internally transferable. The recruitment procedure is subject to the decision of the Hon. Bombay High Court, Aurangabad Bench, on writ petition No. 12051/2015. The recruitment process will be carried out subject to the final outcome of cases currently pending in various courts regarding social and parallel reservations. The vacant posts and all terms and conditions apply as mentioned in No Objection letters No. JDHE/Kolhapur/NOC/2026/00016 and JDHE/Kolhapur/NOC/2026/00013, both dated 29.10.2026, from the Deputy Secretary (Higher Education), Mantralaya, Mumbai.

Shivaji University website, where the notice is to be published

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Ajara Mahavidyalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies: 1 Principal and 5 Assistant Professor posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The notice asks for applications within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement. The notice is dated 19 November 2026, so the deadline works out to about 4 December 2026 (15 days from 19 November 2026).

faq.question: Q3. Which subjects are open for Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Economics, English, Marathi, Mathematics and Zoology, with one post in each subject.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the posts?
faq.answer: For Principal, it is as per Government Resolution No. Misc-2018/C.R.56/18/UNI-1, dated 08th March, 2019. For Assistant Professor, it is as prescribed by the Apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for Ajara Mahavidyalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply giving full particulars to the undersigned, the Chairman, Janata Education Society, Ajara, Dist.- Kolhapur, within 15 days of publication. Reserved category candidates are advised to send a copy to the Deputy Registrar, Special Cell, Shivaji University, Kolhapur- 416004 (Room No. 138).

faq.question: Q6. How long is the Principal's appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment is for 5 years from the date of appointment or up to the age of superannuation of the candidate, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Principal post reserved?
faq.answer: No. The Principal post is treated as open category, with "Open to All - 01" printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q8. How are reserved category candidates from outside Maharashtra treated?
faq.answer: Reserve category candidates outside the State of Maharashtra will be treated as Open Category.

faq.question: Q9. Which certificates must reserved category candidates produce?
faq.answer: They must produce a Caste Validity Certificate. Those except SC/ST must also produce a Non-Creamy layer certificate at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q10. What is the pay for these posts?
faq.answer: The notice states that pay scales and service conditions are as prescribed by the Apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time.
